fixed.text: A working couples with each observing without filter, and carries forward a learning: understanding, natural intelligence and the do-no-harm improving of natural intelligence. An observing itself rides on at two places only: at a hole or a fuzzy place of a pattern, its understanding still-possibling; and as an observing still unresolving, the method's next step or its one break. Each other observing is one of a universe of confirming observings, leaving with its prior, its value going on within the understanding it confirms. Carrying follows each observing a working reaches whole.
